title: Milestone escrow: rolling evidence runway for SOC2/ISO, SSO/SAML, and audit-log readiness
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Establish a rolling milestone escrow and evidence-runway process that prevents last-minute evidence deficits during SOC2/ISO audits and SSO/SAML + audit-log cutovers. The goal is to define cadence, owner rotations, automated checks, and fallbacks so that each compliance gate maintains >=95% evidence completeness with a 3-day remediation SLA. This initiative spans product, infra, security, and documentation teams and includes both technical artifact collection (audit logs, KMS configs, SSO metadata) and human attestations (policy sign-offs, runbook approvals).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Defined milestone escrow playbook published in Confluence; 2) Owner rotation schedule implemented and automation assigned; 3) Evidence completeness metric in console displaying percent-of-required-evidence by gate; 4) 3-day remediation workflow integrated with oncall and PM alerts; 5) Two-week pilot across SOC2 evidence buckets showing >=95% completeness

notes: Trade-off: full evidence automation requires work across multiple teams and will not cover human attestations. We accept a staged approach: automate machine-verifiable artifacts first.
Decision log: use a rolling monthly escrow owner rotation rather than per-cycle to reduce onboarding churn for owners.
Risk: multi-tenant tenants with custom SSO may require manual steps; mitigation: include a 'custom-flow flag' that surfaces those tenants to Security ops weekly.
Fallback: if automation fails for a gate, route to oncall + temporary escrow bucket with manual checklist and 3-day SLA.
